note: Washington County Conservation Board's main park, 1 mile west of Ainsworth on Highway 92. Open pad rows in a grove; dump station free for campers. Conservation Education Center, playgrounds and trails in the park. The 1.2-acre north pond is ~100 m east of the loop and the 5.7-acre mini-lake ~200 m SE, both across the park road, not at the pads. --Claude
